node.title: N=512 four-singleton E1 collision exclusion
node.statement: At N=512,s=2, a folded profile (a,b,c)=(0,4,0) has four distinct coefficients in {+1,-1}. Its negacyclic autocorrelation variance V is even. If V=0 its cyclotomic norm is the pure power 2^256; if V=2 an exact primitive-power-of-two product gives geometric conjugate-square mean G<19/5; if V>=4 a uniform logarithmic deficit gives G<180/47. In the latter cases |Norm(alpha)|=G^128<2^250, while no odd row prime divides the V=0 norm. Hence this profile cannot collide at any pair-feasible anchor, leaving only (1,2,0) in the first N=512 band.
node.notes: ROUTE REDUCTION 2026-07-27: closes one of the two first-band N=512 profiles by exact norm structure. It does not control profile (1,2,0), later bands, or the total collision-pair ledger.
